Senzo Meyiwa Gunned Down

By: Nicky Troll | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
as the country mourns the shooting of Bafana Bafana goalkeeper we speak those close to him.

Summary:
Like Bongani Masuku, another well-known South African looses his life to an apparent senseless crime.

Bafana Bafana Captain & goalkeeper, Senzo Meyiwa, was at his prime - representing Bafana Bafana in recent months, and in the four AFCON qualifiers played to date he was yet to concede a goal.

Armed men entered his girlfriend's house - Senzo stepped in to protect his girlfriend and was shot in the back.

No arrests have been as yet. This story is being covered internationally - I think it's important for our viewers that we tell this story as well.



Further information:
The 27-year-old Bafana Bafana and Orlando Pirates goalkeeper was shot dead at about 20:00 on Sunday.

The incident happened at a house in the Zamo Section in Vosloorus, the SA police service said.

"There were 7 people inside the house. Two suspects went into the house, one remained outside. The 3 fled on foot after the shooting," SAPS tweeted on Sunday.

No one else was injured. Malila said Meyiwa had been in a house with friends, as well as with girlfriend Kelly Khumalo.

"We can assure all South Africans that we will do all [we] can to bring Meyiwa's killers [to] book," SAPS said.

Police have offered a R150 000 reward for information that could lead to the arrest of the killers.

Press Release:


Senzo Meyiwa murder
Soccer star Senzo Meyiwa was brutally gunned down in Vosloorus last Sunday. As South Africa and the sporting world mourn yet another senseless murder, Carte Blanche reflects on his life on and off the field.


Script:


VO: It’s believed to be a robbery gone wrong.

Police report that two suspects entered the house demanding money and cellphones, a scuffle ensued and a shot was fired - killing Senzo Meyiwa.

LINK: Another high-profile South African looses his life to crime throwing the spot light yet again on our violent reality.

VO: Police Top Brass jumped in to action on Monday.

UPSOUND: PRESS CONFERENCE:
PHIYEGA: It’s not about who you are – it’s about our ability to crack some of these cases.

VO: Back in Senzo’s hometown of Umlazi just south of Durban, his family and father, Samuel Meyiwa, are still battling to come to terms with the murder.

Sam: What did he do? Because he was so respect, uSenzo, he was so very respectful, I don’t know, they must tell me why they did it - // my heart is sore, he’s dead... (in Zulu)

VO: The married sport star was visiting his girlfriend local musician Kelly Khumalo when he was shot.

MATHAWE: He was at the peak of his career, he was doing very well and now this. And in a short space of time, his there is all this scandal and then suddenly he dies.

VO: Drum Magazine Entertainment Editor, Mathawe Matsapola says Senzo’s love triangle was widely publicized over the last year.

He leaves behind his wife Mandisa Mkhize with two young daughters and his girlfriend, Kelly Khumalo with a baby girl.

At just 27, Senzo’s life has been cut short.

Sam: They’ve killed me, we were so happy to see a bright light and that his dreams were coming true.

VO: Senzo’s murder came as a shock to the football fraternity. Emotions ran high at Orlando Pirates head quarters at a press conference on Monday.

UPSOUND PRESS CONFERENCE
SHAKES: Senzo was very kind person, I’d never seen Senzo been sad or angry around the camp.

VO: With many players breaking down, even Bafana Bafana Coach Shakes Mashaba battled to hold it together.

SHAKES: I mean to sit in that press conference look at all the players that Senzo was playing together – that’s what struck me, he is no more, we are not going to see him no more.

VOO: When Shakes got the call on Sunday night, he rushed to Vosloorus.

SHAKES: I had this hope that when I get there they’ll say no it’s a wrong report – the man is alive, maybe he is getting treatment – the hospital was full, because people wanted to come and make sure – and you could see the anger in their faces.

VO: The shock of his death has ripped through the sporting world, TV personality Carol Tshabala says it’s still hard to believe.

CAROL: It was still quite surreal, utter confusion. Because you know he wasn’t an individual who was confrontational, and he was so well liked and the circumstances under which it happened, it’s just absolutely devastating.

LINK: Not long after the shooting, rumours started circulating that perhaps this wasn’t just a robbery.

VO: The public have voiced some interesting theories on social media.

MATHAWE: They’ve are mixed feelings, mixed reactions - some are blaming Kelly, some are saying it’s actually Kaizer Chiefs fans

VO: But even Coach Shakes feels some things just don’t add up.

SHAKES: Couldn’t this guy realise this was Senzo, couldn’t that guy say, hey, it’s Senzo, I don't think these guys were under pressure – unless there is something that I don't know, for them to come in and still say give us cellphones, they cant tell me they didn’t see these peoples faces.
MATHAWE: Who doesnt know Senzo Meyiwa – for heavens sake he is the number goal keeper for orldano pirates, and I mean, its Kelly khumalo’s house – people in Vosloorus should know it’s her house and they saw this big car parked outside and when you get into the house you see there is your star – and you shoot him? For what? A cellphone? No life is worth a cellphone!

VO: Gauteng Spokesperson, Brigadier Neville Malila says they have set up a multi-disciplinary team to investigate this high-profile case.

MALILIA: What we are investigating is a house robbery as well as a murder – if we pick up anything else then we will expand the investigation to include that.

VO: After offering a R250k reward, information has come streaming in with the release of these identikits of the suspects.

MALILA: The information has taken out outside of the province, including KZN and other parts of the country – we are following the leads from the community.

LINK: The tributes poured in from far and wide, local and international fans –FIFA’s Sept Blatter and even soccer legend Gary Lineker

VO: Football journalist Joe Crann has been inundated with enquiries from overseas media.

JOE: Now he’s known all over the world – and it’s just sad that it’s for the wrong reasons – but we’ve seen people like Steven Gerhard, Issi Cassisia, Gary Lineker and michael Essien – big, big names in world football

VO: Coach Shakes says it was a matter of time before Senzo would be playing with the big names.

SHAKES: The question of him getting a contract, this is what was making me cry sometimes, it was not even around the corner. It was staring Senzo in the eyes like this.

VO: Senzo’s had earned his stripes – starting at just 13, he joined Orlando Pirate’s Development Academy. Shakes met him in 2007 as young man waiting to break through.

SHAKES: At that time he was behaving like a baby you know, he always playing, he was always playful, I’m coaching myself, it’s going to take a long time for you to break into the team.

VO: It took Senzo another 5 years before he got the prized starting position as Orlando Pirates goalkeeper. Senzo admitted to taking Shakes’ advice to heart, in a recent interview.

UPSOUND SUPERSPORT STUDIO:
SENZO: he is very strict that man – I used to joke a lot around the field…

JOE: his attitude was key, his attitude and his patience that is what makes a footballer talent isnt everything – talent is about 70% - the rest is attitude and making sure you have the staying power to stick it out.

LINK: After waiting patiently for so many years, Senzo finally got a spot on the national team and he didn’t disappoint, his star was on the rise.

SHAKES: If you look at the record that Senzo played, it could be 107/109 games, and if you check how many goals he conceded – less! And in the Bafana Bafana, he hadn’t concede a goal, but one when the played a practice match against Australia. I mean how do you doubt a person like that.

VO: One of soccer journo Joe Crann’s favourite Senzo moments – was a CAF Champions League game in the Congo last year where Senzo was dubbed the king of Lubumbashi.

JOE: TP Mosembe needed on more goal to go through, they got a contentious penalty given for them against Pirates, Senzo saved it, then later in the game they get another penalty – and Senzo saved it again and I think that was the game that shot him to stardom.

LINK: Shakes Mashaba was impressed with Senzo leadership style that he abandoned his initial idea of rotating the captainsy of the team.

VO: Senzo became a link between the players and technical coaching team – setting up a small committee to deal with player concerns.

SHAKES: He will come to us and say, there’s no problems everything is sorted out, we are marching on, we’ve got to go and win – and that’s when I realised we have got a leader here.

VO: And Senzo’s positive attitude could even be felt on the field.

SHAKES: Even if we scored a goal – he doesn’t stand like a lonely somebody in the goal – he’ll go around area, go in front of the stands and cheer people to celebrate.

VO: Supersport’s Carol says he was entertaining, even off the field.

CAROL: He would always be singing, in the team bus for Bafana Bafana, Orlando Pirates // we’d ask some of the players and they’d say he’s like the choir leader.

VO: But away from the field Senzo’s personal life took centre stage says Mathawe from Drum.

MATHAWE: It has all the ingredients to be a soap opera – with the cat fights, break ups, make ups, that’s how juicy this whole love triangle is

VO: In the last year Senzo has been back and forth between Mandisa - his wife, and Kelly - his girlfriend.

MATHAWE: He clearly loved Kelly, he also clearly loved the wife

VO: Despite a very public a make up with his wife, Mandisa, in April this year, it only lasted a few months. Kelly and Senzo appeared publically with Kelly re-enforcing the relationship with a stream of social media pictures.

Senzo’s family didn’t share his love for Kelly.

MATHAWE: The family always said to him we do not want Kelly, because we believe she is a witch, they actually called her those names, she was a witch, she was a gold digger, she was only after his money ande they actually said to him she is going to destroy your career.

VO: Desperate for answers, the Meyiwa family have employed their own private investigator.

CAROL: He’s certainly once again cast the spotlight on crime stats// if it can happen to an individual like Senzo – you know, a national icon, an ambassador, someone that was just so loved,

VO: On Friday afternoon, a 25-year old suspect was arrested after being identified by witnesses in a line up.

Government is serious about getting results.

UPSOUND CRIME SCENE
Gauteng MEC for Community Safety, Sizakele Nkosi-Malobane (very teary)
We will also make secure a conviction that we put these guys away for a very long time.

SHAKES: A hungry stomach knows no law, a hungry stomach knows no law – people are not even scared of coming into your house. if not Senzo, who? No one is designed to die and the way Senzo did.



PROMOS
PROMO 1
VO: Bafana Bafana Captain, Senzo Meyiwa shot and killed - we reflect on his life on and off the field.

MATHAWE: He was at the peak of his career // And in a short space of time, his there is all this scandal and then suddenly he dies.


PROMO 2
VO: The football fraternity mourns of death of Bafana Bafana Captain Senzo Meyiwa.

SHAKES: that’s what struck me, he is no more, we are not going to see him no more.

VO: We find out about his life on and off the field.

UPSOUND SUPERSPORT STUDIO: SENZO: he is very strict that man – I used to joke a lot around the field… JOE: his attitude was key, his attitude and his patience that is what makes a footballer talent isnt everything – talent is about 70% - the rest is attitude and making sure you have the staying power to stick it out. LINK: After waiting patiently for so many years, Senzo finally got a spot on the national team and he didn’t disappoint, his star was on the rise. SHAKES: If you look at the record that Senzo played, it could be 107/109 games, and if you check how many goals he conceded – less! And in the Bafana Bafana, he hadn’t concede a goal, but one when the played a practice match against Australia. I mean how do you doubt a person like that. VO: One of soccer journo Joe Crann’s favourite Senzo moments – was a CAF Champions League game in the Congo last year where Senzo was dubbed the king of Lubumbashi. JOE: TP Mosembe needed on more goal to go through, they got a contentious penalty given for them against Pirates, Senzo saved it, then later in the game they get another penalty – and Senzo saved it again and I think that was the game that shot him to stardom. LINK: Shakes Mashaba was impressed with Senzo leadership style that he abandoned his initial idea of rotating the captainsy of the team. VO: Senzo became a link between the players and technical coaching team – setting up a small committee to deal with player concerns. SHAKES: He will come to us and say, there’s no problems everything is sorted out, we are marching on, we’ve got to go and win – and that’s when I realised we have got a leader here. VO: And Senzo’s positive attitude could even be felt on the field. SHAKES: Even if we scored a goal – he doesn’t stand like a lonely somebody in the goal – he’ll go around area, go in front of the stands and cheer people to celebrate. VO: Supersport’s Carol says he was entertaining, even off the field. CAROL: He would always be singing, in the team bus for Bafana Bafana, Orlando Pirates // we’d ask some of the players and they’d say he’s like the choir leader. VO: But away from the field Senzo’s personal life took centre stage says Mathawe from Drum. MATHAWE: It has all the ingredients to be a soap opera – with the cat fights, break ups, make ups, that’s how juicy this whole love triangle is VO: In the last year Senzo has been back and forth between Mandisa - his wife, and Kelly - his girlfriend. MATHAWE: He clearly loved Kelly, he also clearly loved the wife VO: Despite a very public a make up with his wife, Mandisa, in April this year, it only lasted a few months. Kelly and Senzo appeared publically with Kelly re-enforcing the relationship with a stream of social media pictures. Senzo’s family didn’t share his love for Kelly. MATHAWE: The family always said to him we do not want Kelly, because we believe she is a witch, they actually called her those names, she was a witch, she was a gold digger, she was only after his money ande they actually said to him she is going to destroy your career. VO: Desperate for answers, the Meyiwa family have employed their own private investigator. CAROL: He’s certainly once again cast the spotlight on crime stats// if it can happen to an individual like Senzo – you know, a national icon, an ambassador, someone that was just so loved, VO: On Friday afternoon, a 25-year old suspect was arrested after being identified by witnesses in a line up. Government is serious about getting results. UPSOUND CRIME SCENE Gauteng MEC for Community Safety, Sizakele Nkosi-Malobane (very teary) We will also make secure a conviction that we put these guys away for a very long time. SHAKES: A hungry stomach knows no law, a hungry stomach knows no law – people are not even scared of coming into your house. if not Senzo, who? No one is designed to die and the way Senzo did. PROMOS PROMO 1 VO: Bafana Bafana Captain, Senzo Meyiwa shot and killed - we reflect on his life on and off the field. MATHAWE: He was at the peak of his career // And in a short space of time, his there is all this scandal and then suddenly he dies. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): as the country mourns the shooting of Bafana Bafana goalkeeper we speak those close to him.
metadata.Summary: Like Bongani Masuku, another well-known South African looses his life to an apparent senseless crime. Bafana Bafana Captain & goalkeeper, Senzo Meyiwa, was at his prime - representing Bafana Bafana in recent months, and in the four AFCON qualifiers played to date he was yet to concede a goal. Armed men entered his girlfriend's house - Senzo stepped in to protect his girlfriend and was shot in the back. No arrests have been as yet. This story is being covered internationally - I think it's important for our viewers that we tell this story as well.
metadata.Further information: The 27-year-old Bafana Bafana and Orlando Pirates goalkeeper was shot dead at about 20:00 on Sunday. The incident happened at a house in the Zamo Section in Vosloorus, the SA police service said. "There were 7 people inside the house. Two suspects went into the house, one remained outside. The 3 fled on foot after the shooting," SAPS tweeted on Sunday. No one else was injured. Malila said Meyiwa had been in a house with friends, as well as with girlfriend Kelly Khumalo. "We can assure all South Africans that we will do all [we] can to bring Meyiwa's killers [to] book," SAPS said. Police have offered a R150 000 reward for information that could lead to the arrest of the killers. INTERVIEWS: SAPS EKLLY KHUMALO - Girlfirend Witnesses (?) Bafana Bafana team mates VOX Pops
